summary: First iteration for Syllo. Backend pytest suite (22 tests) covering auth (login/register/logout/me/google-bogus), subjects/units/lessons CRUD + cascade delete, notebooks CRUD + updated_at bump, tasks CRUD + completed_at, sessions with lesson total_seconds + streak update, Today aggregate, Analytics (14 daily buckets), unauth 401 protection across endpoints, user isolation, and seed on fresh user - ALL 22 PASS (100%). Frontend playwright suite (12 flows) covering login->today, today tasks + toggle persistence via API, subjects list (>=4 seeded), create subject modal, subject detail expand unit + lesson status cycle (persistence verified), notebooks autosave indicator (Saving -> Saved), tasks tabs open/done/all + create, focus timer start/reset, analytics daily-bars, theme toggle (light<->dark on html class), sign out redirect - ALL 12 PASS with 0 console errors. No em dashes in user-facing text.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~800 lines; consider splitting into routers/{auth,subjects,units,lessons,notebooks,tasks,sessions,analytics}.py for maintainability.
CORS default is '*' with allow_credentials=True which browsers ignore; production CORS_ORIGINS must be set explicitly for cookies to work cross-site (currently works via same-origin ingress).
Cookies are SameSite=None; Secure - fine for the emergent preview HTTPS domain; document that local http dev would need adjustment.
Streak logic in _update_streak: if delta==0 (backwards-dated started_at earlier than last_day) it keeps current unchanged - acceptable but could log a warning.
PATCH /tasks does not clear completed_at when completed toggled back to false; minor data hygiene issue but not user-visible.
seed_data_creation: Backend startup seeds demo user with 4 subjects, 12 units, 36 lessons, 5 tasks, 3 notebooks, 7 sessions, streak. Tests create their own TEST_-prefixed data under fresh users (not cleaned up but harmless in fresh accounts).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_syllo_backend.py and run cleanly against REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Note: EmailStr rejects .test TLD - use example.com or syllo.app for test emails. Frontend testids use pattern like today-task-toggle-<id>, subject-card-<id>, unit-toggle-<id>, lesson-status-<id>, tasks-tab-<open|done|all>, notebook-item-<id>, notebook-autosave-indicator (Saving/Saved), nav-<page>, theme-toggle-button, sign-out-button. Google OAuth callback only tested for rejection with bogus session_id (endpoint returns 401).
